newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST - Italy shares and bonds to rise up to June.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Italy shares and bonds to rise up to June.

text.p: Italian shares and bond prices are expected to see a moderate rise up until end-June, a survey by Italy's Association of dealers Assobat showed on Tuesday.

On shares, some 54 percent of dealers asked in the survey forecast a moderate rise in prices, some 24.5 percent saw steady prices, while 13.7 percent saw a modest fall. Some 3.9 percent saw a strong rise and the same percentage number a strong fall.

For gross yields on BTP bond, with a reference yield of 8.09 percent at end-March, some 38.2 percent of dealers in the survey saw a moderate fall in yields up to June, and 32.4 percent forecast steady yields while 29.4 percent saw a moderate rise.
After a general rise in bond prices since the end of March, the yield on the benchmark 10-year BTP bond has fallen back to 7.56 percent today.
Looking at BOT short term bills, some 39 percent saw a moderate fall in yields, some 30 percent predicted stable yields with 18 percent seeing a moderate rise, while 13 percent forecast a strong fall
